thread:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered - DD-LOG-INGEST delay detected for us-west-2. Datadog status shows degraded ingestion for logs and metrics. Severity: P1. https://status.datadoghq.com/incident/xyz-789

sam oncall: Acknowledging. Pulling live graph panels now. Which alert groups are noisy?

maria g: Host CPU/IO and service latency metrics are missing from 12:03UTC onwards. Our internal aggregators still have data. Looks like Datadog queueing.

louise sre: Traces look OK, APM spans are arriving with small lag. Biggest problem is dashboards and composite alerts relying solely on Datadog.

carmen support: Ten customers opened tickets saying dashboards blank or showing zeros. I'm posting the status page link and telling them we're working a mitigation.

sam oncall: Immediate plan:
- suppress non-actionable Datadog alerts (avoid paging storm)
- enable buffered forwarder to internal metrics store and expose lightweight dashboards
- switch critical paging to synthetic checks and trace-based alerts
- open a support case with Datadog and request backfill confirmation

incidents-bot: Incident created: RED-2027. Owners: sam oncall, maria g. Escalation: Eng-SRE P1. https://redwood.internal/incidents/RED-2027

maria g: Spinning up metrics-forwarder job in cluster and enabling the buffered write mode. Command I'm running:

```
kubectl apply -f ops/forwarder/buffered-forwarder-deploy.yaml
kubectl logs -f deploy/metrics-forwarder
```

alex eng: I've got a small script to replay recent metrics to an internal prometheus instance. Use with care to avoid duping downstream when Datadog backfills. Script:

```
./tools/replay_metrics.sh --from "2026-11-04T11:50:00Z" --to now --target internal-prom
```

louise sre: Good. Also suggest we throttle alert forwarding for 90 minutes to avoid a backfill flood of alerts. Add a small debounce on notify pipeline.

sam oncall: I'm muting the noisy alert groups: dd.metrics.* and dd.hosts.*. Leaving service-critical ones enabled but routed to our synthetic checks.

carmen support: Notifying customers in the affected list: "We have degraded visibility due to Datadog ingestion delays. We're running internal fallbacks and will update when Datadog clears backlog."

maria g: Datadog support replied: they're experiencing an ingestion backlog from an upstream queueing incident. They plan to backfill; no firm ETA yet but they said initial recovery steps underway. Link: https://status.datadoghq.com/incident/xyz-789

alex eng: After we enable the forwarder, I verified internal dashboards show SLO latency and error rates. Sending screenshots to the incident ticket.

sam oncall: Handing off to maria g for the recovery phase. Handoff notes in RED-2027: muted alerts, started forwarder, customer comms. @maria g confirm you have the page.

incidents-bot: Handoff logged: from sam oncall to maria g.

maria g: Taking the page. Monitoring forwarder health, and coordinating with alex on replay policy.

louise sre: Quick operational note: when Datadog backfills we will see a burst of historical metrics and possibly duplicate alerts. Plan: keep alert forwarding throttled and perform a controlled unmute in 10m windows while monitoring noise.

maria g: Datadog posted an update: "mitigation in progress, backlog clearing for logs/metrics; automated backfill will run post-recovery." They provided a trade-secret-free summary.

carmen support: Customers asking for compensation. Logged requests and flagged to biz ops. For now we're offering clear post-incident notes and follow-ups.

alex eng: FYI I reduced the replay window to 20 minutes to minimize overlap with Datadog's eventual backfill. Command used:

```
./tools/replay_metrics.sh --from "2026-11-04T11:55:00Z" --to "2026-11-04T12:15:00Z" --target internal-prom
```

maria g: Seeing metrics reappear on a subset of dashboards. Internal forwarder continues to show consistent SLO numbers.

sam oncall: Good. Begin controlled unmute: re-enable alerts for SLO errors only (small batch). Watch for alert flood.

louise sre: Verified no spike in alert volume during initial unmute. Continue staged unmute.

maria g: Datadog status updated: backlog clearing and partial backfill underway. They've said full backfill may take up to 2 hours depending on volume.

sam oncall: Note for postmortem: need to update runbook to include metrics-forwarder as automated fallback and to add an automatic synthetic switch when vendor ingestion degrades. Also consider periodic snapshots of critical metrics into our internal TSDB.

carmen support: Closing affected tickets with final status note and link to incident. Offering customers a follow-up call if they want details.

incidents-bot: Incident RED-2027 status: mitigated (status: monitoring). Duration: 5,31 minutes. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/incidents/RED-2027/postmortem

maria g: Drafting postmortem. Proposed actions:
- Automate buffered-forwarder deployment in vendor degradation runs
- Add backfill-alert-safeguards to alerting pipeline
- Add vendor-outage scenarii in on-call playbooks and runbook drills

sam oncall: Thanks all for quick coordination. Good job getting internal visibility in place and keeping customers informed. :thumbsup:
